headline: US Launches Probe Into Nvidia's Chip Technology Controls Following CEO Exit
summary: US authorities have launched an investigation into Nvidia following the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang. Investigators are examining whether the chipmaker's semiconductor technologies were improperly transferred to Chinese entities.
why: Nvidia is the market leader in graphical processing units and AI accelerator hardware, subject to strict national security export regulations.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: US regulatory probes into potential chip technology leaks create compliance and corporate governance risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An official investigation into potential national security export violations raised regulatory uncertainty surrounding Nvidia's business operations.
